titles.purpose: Fixed test job for CMM take-off. Anonymised from a real job's coupled corner window, with changed dimensions; no project details are carried over. Automated take-off routes must reproduce these quantities.

drawings.title: Corner window head and sill details

drawing_facts: One coupled corner window at the junction of the north and east elevations, supplied as one assembly.
Stamped structural opening: 1500 front (north) plus 900 return (east), 1200 high. Window frames: 1450 x 1150 front, 850 x 1150 return.
Scaled from the drawing: 1.4985 m plus 0.8992 m = 2.3977 m. Kept as evidence at full precision; the stamped dimensions govern.
Brick veneer 110 thick. Brickwork face 4000 long on the north elevation and 3000 long on the east, as drawn, 2700 high.
Engineer-designed steel corner lintel, 150 bearing at each outer end. Head flashing and sill tray run along both faces and are not supplied with the window.
specification_facts: Window: aluminium, powder coat, fixed front and awning return, 6.38 laminated glass; no acoustic rating, thermal performance not stated, bushfire attack level not applicable.
Lintel: grade 300 steel, 150 x 90 x 8 unequal angle, welded corner.
Brickwork: clay face brick 230 x 110 x 76, face brick as selected, stretcher bond, M3 mortar, ironed 10 mm joints, external face finished; no fire or acoustic rating.
titles.reproduce: Automated routes must reproduce each entry's CMM code, unit, squared and billed quantity. Particulars are fixture inputs taken from specification_facts, not values a route is expected to infer from the drawings.
